name: RAD50 interactor 1
pathways: mitotic G2 DNA damage checkpoint signaling
regulation of ER to Golgi vesicle-mediated transport

function.text: RINT1 encodes RAD50-interacting protein 1. It participates in mitotic G2 DNA damage checkpoint signaling and regulation of ER to Golgi vesicle-mediated transport.

germline.text: Retained constitutional disease associations include infantile liver failure syndrome 3 (autosomal recessive). Pathogenicity and inheritance depend on the specific allele and disorder.

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; strong GenCC assertion from Labcorp Genetics (formerly Invitae). Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
